claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the color-changing effect, describing it as working well and being fun and temperature-sensitive.
Many note the polish is sheer and requires multiple coats (often 3 or more) to achieve a solid color.
Several reviewers mention the polish peels off easily, though some see this as acceptable or manageable with a topcoat.
Some reviewers report easy application and removal, with good brushes and consistency.
A few negative reviews cite poor quality, including colors not matching pictures, no color change, and difficulty removing.
